sql: select status, count(*) as n, round(avg(extract(epoch from (updated_at - created_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) as avg_hours_to_status, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from (updated_at - created_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) as p50_hours from paper_trades where strategy = 'mmsell10' and created_at > now() - interval '7 days' group by status order by n desc
